Jordan (support): heads-up — getting a pile of customer reports hitting 500s from /v1/infer when they should be getting 429s. customers see \"internal server error\" and some trace ids. opening thread for triage.
Jordan (support): example curl from customer: 
```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
x-request-id: rq_01GXXXX
content-type: application/json
```
Jordan (support): ticket links: <https://support.redwood.ai/t/4583|#4583>, #4590, #4591. multiple orgs in east/us region.
Meera (oncall): thanks. do we have correlation with quota/rate-limiter logs? last deploy? any changes to fallback routing?
Alex (eng-sre): looking. quick summary: yesterday's rate-router change (canary) added fallback routing to quota-orchestrator v2 under high load. I see timeouts from quota-orchestrator -> auth-cache causing 504s which are bubbling as 500 at the API.
Alex (eng-sre): grep of gateway logs for trace rq_01GXXXX: 
```
[2026-03-12T18:42:11Z] gateway: req=rq_01GXXXX route=/v1/infer backend=quota-orch svc_error=upstream timeout
[2026-03-12T18:42:11Z] gateway: classify_error=500 reason=dep_timeout
```
Meera (oncall): so gateway is classifying as 500 not 429. where should 429 come from? quota should respond 429 when limit exceeded. 5xx happens for dependency timeouts or misroutes.
Jordan (support): customers reporting this when traffic spikes or when they exceed burst. they expect 429 & Retry-After. not 500 which causes our SDKs to retry and double charge tokens.
Sophie (prod): high priority. if this is a misroute or timeout turning into 500, we need a short mitigation: prefer fast-path check that returns 429 when possible, or route to tokenless limiter that returns 429.
Alex (eng-sre): immediate mitigation plan: 1) add a gateway classifier rule: if backend is quota-orch and error contains \"rate_limit\" or \"quota_exceeded\" mark as 429; 2) lower timeout threshold between gateway and quota-orch from 2s -> 500ms for fallback decisions (so we fail fast and let caller handle 429).
Meera (oncall): can we do hotfix? any risk of false 429s?
Alex (eng-sre): small risk briefly, but better UX. I'll push a narrow patch to the gateway rule engine and roll canary to 10% in us-east.
